Container.Name: No-Fixed-Address
Container.Overview: Self-hosted dynamic DNS for Cloudflare DNS. Keeps A (and optionally AAAA) records pointed at your server's current public IP address, so names like home.example.com keep working after your ISP changes it. There is no third-party account to renew or confirm every month: all it needs is a Cloudflare API token limited to the zones your records are in. It can also notify you through Discord, Slack, ntfy, Gotify, Apprise or any webhook. It checks at startup and then every 5 minutes by default, and only writes when something has changed. Set Dry run to true for the first start to see what it would change without changing anything. The project page has step-by-step setup instructions, including creating the token.
Container.Requires: A domain whose DNS is hosted on Cloudflare, and a Cloudflare API token limited to the zones your records are in. The project page explains how to create the token.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: A Cloudflare API token with Zone / Zone / Read and Zone / DNS / Edit permissions, limited to the zones your records are in. Create it under My Profile, API Tokens in the Cloudflare dashboard. The README has step-by-step instructions.

Config.Name: Records
Config.Description: Comma-separated full names to keep updated, for example home.example.com,vpn.example.com (not just home). They can be in different domains: each name's zone is found automatically. One name is often enough: point your other names at it with CNAME records.

Config.Name: Check interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to check whether the public IP has changed. 300 is every 5 minutes, 3600 is hourly, 86400 is once a day. A check always runs when the container starts.

Config.Name: Update A records (IPv4)
Config.Description: Keep A records pointed at the public IPv4 address.

Config.Name: Update AAAA records (IPv6)
Config.Description: Keep AAAA records pointed at the public IPv6 address. The container needs IPv6 connectivity for this: use Host networking or a custom network with IPv6 enabled.

Config.Name: Proxied
Config.Description: true or false to set Cloudflare's proxy on every record, or blank to leave each record as it is. Records used for VPNs, game servers and similar must not be proxied.

Config.Name: Create missing records
Config.Description: Create records that do not exist yet. When false, a missing record is logged as an error and skipped.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: Log what would change without changing anything. Useful for the first start.

Config.Name: Notification URL
Config.Description: Optional webhook to tell you when records change, when something needs attention, and when it works again: a Discord or Slack webhook, an ntfy topic, a Gotify or Apprise API URL, or anything that accepts JSON or text. Blank turns notifications off. The README explains where each URL comes from.

Config.Name: Notification format
Config.Description: auto recognises Discord and Slack webhook URLs. For any other service, choose it here.

Config.Name: TTL (seconds)
Config.Description: 1 for automatic, or 60 to 86400. Blank leaves each record's TTL as it is. Ignored for proxied records, which always use automatic TTL.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug also logs every check and API call, which helps when reporting a problem. The token and the notification URL are never logged.

Config.Name: API token file
Config.Description: Alternative to the API token field: the path inside the container of a file holding the token, mapped in with a Path. Set one or the other, not both.

Config.Name: IPv4 lookup URLs
Config.Description: Comma-separated URLs used to find the public IPv4 address, tried in order. Use https:// URLs. Blank uses https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace, https://api.ipify.org and https://ifconfig.me/ip.

Config.Name: IPv6 lookup URLs
Config.Description: Comma-separated URLs used to find the public IPv6 address, tried in order. Use https:// URLs. Blank uses https://[2606:4700:4700::1111]/cdn-cgi/trace and https://api6.ipify.org.

Config.Name: API URL
Config.Description: Leave blank. Only for testing against a stand-in for the Cloudflare API: the API token is sent to this URL.

Config.Name: State directory
Config.Description: Leave blank. Where the health check's timestamp is kept; defaults to /tmp/nofixedaddress.
